facts.fact: 'Defective' means the Institute Nodal Officer or the Scheme Nodal Officer has marked the application defective; the student can then update (correct) it
facts.quote: How can I update my application if it has been marked as defective? Application may be marked defective by Institute Nodal officers or Scheme Nodal officer

facts.fact: To fix a defect in scheme details: in My Applications click Proceed against the Application ID, open Fill/Edit Application form, make the corrections and submit the application again
facts.quote: Click on Proceed button provided against the Application ID in My Applications. Click on Fill/Edit Application form menu. Make the corrections and submit the Application.

facts.fact: A defect in Basic Information can be corrected only when the student has just one active application (other applications must be withdrawn first)
facts.quote: If there is more than 1 active application then you have to withdraw all the other applications in order to make the corrections in Basic information.

facts.fact: For 2026-27, defective-application verification is open till 15-11-2026 for most schemes, so the corrected application must be resubmitted before then
facts.quote: Defective Application Verification Open till:15-11-2026 Institute Verification Open till:15-11-2026
facts.note: Scheme-wise dates on Schemes on NSP; PM YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools has 15-12-2026.

behaviour: Explains in general what 'defective' means on NSP and how to correct and resubmit the application, citing NSP; says it cannot see the user's application record and points to the NSP login / application status to read the defect remarks.
